facts: A pair of threshold objects (Basalt Threshold Pillars) stands 1.0-3.0 m inside the door, with a hanging screen (Rain Curtain) between them; the route slips through a 1.9 m gap.
The hero (Wet Obsidian Monolith) stands alone in an empty 8 x 7 m area (Empty Reflection Void); the route circles it and never comes closer than 3.3 m.
Four product stations (Eyewear Stations) sit at the outer corners, outside the loop, so you turn away from the hero to reach them.
The pay desk (Monolith Pay Desk) closes the loop at the back wall.
anchors: standing just inside the door, between the threshold objects; you look at the Basalt Threshold Pillars (rock)
at the edge of the void, facing the hero; you look at the Wet Obsidian Monolith (rock)
turned away from the hero, at a product station; you look at the Eyewear Stations (display)

materials.where: basalt threshold pillars, wet obsidian monolith

args.title: The Rainy Threshold
args.subtitle: Seongsu Flagship Store
args.line: Where the sound of rain fades into silent stone and light.
args.synopsis: You step past the threshold pillars into a hushed space where the outside storm instantly vanishes. Before you lies the Wet Obsidian Monolith, standing in solitary stillness amid polished concrete. You wander around the empty void, discovering eyewear resting upon minimalist displays at the edges of the room.
args.quote: Silence is carved in stone when the rain stops.
why: They filter the noisy exterior world, preparing you to enter a serene interior.
It commands your attention from afar, anchoring the vast emptiness of the room.
They invite you to pause and examine the eyewear in intimate corners away from the central void.
It completes your circular journey through the dark gallery before you step back out.
